title: Netezza Exit to BigQuery
subtitle: Netezza + Informatica + Tableau → BigQuery
description: Our Netezza appliance (90 TB) reaches end of support next year. Informatica PowerCenter loads it and Tableau dashboards sit on top. We want a serverless BigQuery platform with lower licensing cost.
